sentences.text: Syco Entertainment , often known simply as Syco , is a British entertainment company established by British entertainment mogul Simon Cowell .	Simon Cowell	Simon Cowell	Entertainment	Entertainment
The company operates a record label , talent agency , film , music , and television production company , as well as a music publishing house .

It operates a global joint venture between Cowell and Sony Music Entertainment focused on the production and marketing of music , television , film and digital content .	Entertainment	Entertainment	Sony Music	Sony Music	Sony Music Entertainment	Sony Music Entertainment

It employs a staff of more than 50 in offices in London and Los Angeles , and manages a string of high-profile television and music brands through partnerships with the label Sony Music and the television production company , FremantleMedia .	London	London	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Sony Music	Sony Music	FremantleMedia	FremantleMedia
Syco was initially owned by Simon Cowell , then sold to Sony .	Simon Cowell	Simon Cowell
But in 2010 , a new company was formed as a 50/50 partnership between Cowell and Sony , keeping the pre-existing name Syco but titled as Syco Entertainment .	Entertainment	Entertainment
In 2015 , it was announced that the Syco Entertainment joint venture would be extended for a further 6 years .	Entertainment	Entertainment
Retail billionaire Sir Philip Green , a close friend of Cowell , serves as an advisor to the company .	Philip Green	Philip Green
Karren Brady , television personality and vice-chairman of West Ham United F.C. , also serves as an advisor to the company .	Karren Brady	Karren Brady
Syco has three main divisions - Syco Music , Syco TV and Syco Film .	Syco TV	Syco TV	Syco Music	Syco Music

Syco Music releases recordings from its roster of artists , mostly from Cowell 's television shows , such as One Direction , Little Mix , Leona Lewis , Susan Boyle , Emblem3 , and Fifth Harmony , and others such as Il Divo .	Syco Music	Syco Music	One Direction	One Direction	Little Mix	Little Mix	Leona Lewis	Leona Lewis	Susan Boyle	Susan Boyle	Emblem3	Emblem3	Fifth Harmony	Fifth Harmony	Il Divo	Il Divo

Syco TV is responsible for The X Factor and the Got Talent television franchise , which have been produced in 41 and 52 countries respectively , as well as other television projects .	Syco TV	Syco TV	The X Factor	The X Factor	Got Talent	Got Talent
Syco Film is involved in the production of films such as One Direction : This Is Us .	One Direction	One Direction
Syco is also involved in the production of the musical I Ca n't Sing !
The X Factor Musical .	The X Factor	The X Factor
